scripts.start:pdf: cd services/pdf && dotnet run --project src/WoWiki.Pdf.Api -- --environment Development
scripts.start:gateway: cd services/gateway && dotnet run --project src/WoWiki.Gateway -- --environment Development
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,auth,pdf,gateway --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:pdf" "npm run start:gateway"
